scope.task: Both papers: what every reading and writing task rests on

target_learner_profile.prior_teaching: Learners who completed a first-language English course at IGCSE or equivalent; no prior knowledge of the AS papers assumed.
target_learner_profile.context: Namibian secondary learners, Cambridge International AS Level, English medium, sitting the October/November 2026 series.
note_purpose: source of record for flashcard generation

assessment_expectations.command_words_note: Only Compare and Analyse are used at AS (syllabus page 23; corpus). Use one only where a slot names it; otherwise use the task form of the paper item the slot models. Never use Discuss.
assessment_expectations.ao_note: The AS weights (page 11): this topic serves both papers. Not a per-topic item-count target.

exposure.principle: RS-05: exposure calibrates emphasis. Every objective in scope is taught and practised.

depth_constraints.excluded_constructs_source: Components this learner does not sit (route 12 and 22). C-11 scans learner-facing text for these exact terms, so they are short terms, not sentences.
stated_in_the_syllabus: The content examples are suggested, not prescribed (page 12): teach the listed features, and never present them as a closed list.
adjacent_topics: the linguistic toolkit — taught in topic 1.2; name it in passing if you must, teach it there
